title: NetBird community content
description: One file per piece of content under data/content/<slug>.yaml. The filename slug is the stable id.

title.description: Title of the video or article, as published.

type.description: Kind of content. video = a video (YouTube, etc.); article = a written tutorial/guide/review; blog = a blog post; misc = anything else (podcast, talk, social thread).

source.description: Creator, channel, or publication that produced it.

publish_date.description: Publish date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional but recommended — it drives ordering (newest first) and any date filter on the site.

featured.description: Maintainer-set. true pins the item into the featured row on netbird.io. Omit for a standard listing.
